pairing.common_randomness_policy: Share only exogenous event draws that the declared causal model says are not affected by the intervention. Recompute all causal descendants.

protocol_claims.published_claim: README describes FIFO action buffering at 100/200/500 ms.
protocol_claims.source_evidence: Pinned agent_wrapper.py invokes the policy, schedules the next invocation at step + delay_ticks, releases the previous command at that step, and holds the current command on intervening ticks.
protocol_claims.next_check: Independent tick-level fixture and CARLA smoke with command generation/application receipts.

perturbation_families.source_observed_semantics: Periodic policy invocation at delay_ticks intervals with a held current command between releases; not a per-tick FIFO of every policy output.

perturbation_families.semantics: Independent reference arm: generate one command every simulation tick and apply each command exactly d ticks after generation, once the initial queue is filled.
Cached/frozen frame behavior; record acquisition frame, delivery frame, cache age and realized burst duration.
